title: Coast Guard Rescues 3 Fishermen from Capsized Vessel, Searching for Master near Quillayute River, Wash.
description: A Coast Guard Station Quillayute River 47-foot Motor Life Boat crew searches for the master of the fishing vessel Sea Beast which capsized near the Quillayute River, May 3, 2015. Three other crewmembers from the Sea Beast were rescued from a life raft by the MLB crew and an MH-65 Dolphin helicopter crew and the crew of the Coast Guard Cutter Blue Shark also assisted in the search. U.S. Coast Guard video by Air Station Port Angeles.
keywords: Port Angeles, Coast Guard rescue, Quillayute River, capsize, Washingotn, Sea Beast, Coast Guard, search and rescue
